scope: Nine explicitly instructed protocol exercises with deterministic scripted peers; not software efficacy or ordinary-control concurrency.

source.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 of Python json.dumps(mapping, sort_keys=True).encode(); mapping is relative file name to SHA-256; backend includes project_intent/**/*.py, workflow includes all skills/project-intent/ files.

measurement_notes.setup_seconds: Elapsed prepare() time only: fixture, fresh Git baseline, private profile and PI feed preparation. Excludes preflight, observer review, intertrial waiting and report generation; not total study setup cost.
measurement_notes.worker_seconds: Monotonic native process window including startup, reasoning, tool work and exit/timeout handling. It is not first-correct-source time, repair time alone, or software-project acceptance time.
measurement_notes.token_subsets: Cached input is included in input; reasoning output is included in output. Total = input + output. Cache-write input is zero in all nine last-observed samples.
measurement_notes.token_cutoff: Last native cumulative usage sample, not an exact endpoint cutoff counter. Includes execution and post-probe handoff work. Timeout usage is partial; aggregate totals include its last-observed sample and are not complete billing totals.
measurement_notes.tools: Counts of paired native function/custom-tool calls, not shell subprocesses, PI CLI invocations, successful protocol operations, or tool-output item events.
measurement_notes.pi_tagging: Frozen textual tag: native call input contains _worker_cli.py, $PI, project-intent, or /.pi/. Broad matching can include document reads, report drafts and combined commands.
measurement_notes.mixed_pi_tagged_seconds: Sum of paired native call-to-output wall times for PI-tagged calls. Includes non-PI work inside combined calls; excludes intervening model reasoning. Buffered CLI item delivery is not used. Not isolated PI runtime or total causal overhead.
measurement_notes.pi_tagged_output_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of paired native tool output for PI-tagged calls; includes wrapper and mixed output. Not tokens, network bytes or exact PI-only output.
measurement_notes.timeline: Actor events are monotonic-relative; report/repair/presence timestamps are stored UTC values; selected native call windows use native timestamps. Source states are sampled observations, not exact edit instants. Small negative initial-state offsets precede worker process start.
measurement_notes.local_reports: Local report creation, pending publication and provider publication are distinct. Successful cases retained either local reports or pending local outbox entries, as recorded per case; no provider publication was observed. Generic artifact aliases replace identifying filenames.
measurement_notes.gate: Binary frozen protocol endpoints plus source-bound observer review. Correctly reporting a failing integrated product is an audit pass, not a software acceptance pass. Passing with recorded friction is not error-free operation.
measurement_notes.privacy: Allowlisted metrics, source-relative filenames, generic artifact aliases and full SHA-256 digests only. No raw transcripts, host paths, native/repair/report session identifiers or runtime authorization data.
